regions.merged_text: Converence "HUMILITY and SIMPLICITY" (Of myself) I am nothing. Only inasmuch as I shall succeed in humbling myself can I expect to anything in God's eye - anything therefore in reality worth seeing. Humility and Simplicity belong together and to one another more than do twin sister.

regions.merged_text: Confer. - "Blessed are the Clean of heart for they shall see God" First law of nature, Self-preservation. Next to this law - nay essentially belonging to it is Self-propagation ..... Whence then the law of Chastity? In general there is no law beinding to perfect Chas- tity. In general it is only a counsel. Chastity becomes a law for the privileged few - for priests and religious who by the grace of vo- cation take it as a holy vow .... all the more effectually to propigate Jesus Christ and themselves spiritually.
